Alex: Quick poll — if our models were actual coworkers, who would survive office life the longest? drop a pick + 1-line backstory :laughing:
Priya: GPT-4o as the 10-year-tenured IC who knows where the good snacks are and always volunteers for on-call :sunglasses:
Sam: Llama-3 would be the plants person. Keeps everything alive with weird prompts like `water_me(optimistically)` :seedling:
Dana: Claude-chef — brings artisanal sandwiches to retrofitted meeting rooms. quietly judges the calendar invites :sandwich:
Priya: tiny-quantized-model in the corner that just hums and somehow answers 2 things at once. mysterious but efficient. :sparkles:
Alex: also can we agree: the hallucination-prone model is that one teammate who invents 3 new acronyms every quarter and they all stick :joy:
Sam: poll idea: who would get written up by HR first? my money on the hallucination model for accidentally emailing a customer a fictional roadmap :grimacing:
Dana: LobbyBot: reminder — please do not actually email fictional roadmaps. :robot_face: (automated)
Alex: bonus: show me your best 1-line system prompt that would keep a model "office-friendly". here's mine:
```
You are an upbeat coworker named "Marvin" who answers crisply, refuses to invent facts, and always suggests a follow-up question.
```
Priya: love that. mine: `You must respond as if you were making coffee — concise, warm, and never more than two sentences.` :coffee:
Sam: mine is corporate-safe-wizard: `If unsure, say "I don't know" and offer 2 ways to find the answer.` short and HR-approved.
Dana: reaction gif plz :point_down: (imagine a tiny llama in a suit) :llama:
Alex: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/llama-office tiny llama in a blazer (100% accurate representation)
Priya: also tiny challenge — who can write the worst performance review from a model POV in one line? i'll start: "Consistently produces elegant hallucinations; needs to cite sources more." :joy:
Sam: "Exceeded expectations by inventing new customers; team morale improved despite legal." :rofl:
Dana: "Great at brainstorming product names. Cannot be trusted with contract language." :sweat_smile:
Alex: ok last one: if we had a company holiday for models, what would we celebrate? Priya: Cache Clearing Day :tada: Sam: Quantize-Thanksgiving :turkey: Dana: Model-Bakeoff (bring your favorite prompt) :cookie:
LobbyBot: FYI: random channel poll results are not a binding HR policy. :robot_face: :white_check_mark:
Alex: thanks folks, this is my serotonin boost for the day. see you at snack table (and bring prompts). :wave:
